summary: Only 8 m of kerb at a school junction with painted islands.
reasons: School loading zone and traffic islands

drivers.seclusion: School grounds to the north; detached house 12 m and a psychology clinic 9 m away on the south side; very exposed at a junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; the kerb is barely a van length and sits beside painted chevron islands at the junction mouth.
drivers.traffic: Busy school drop-off area with a loading zone and through traffic from the junction.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the next stretch; 1P signs weekdays and a passenger loading zone at school times.

flags: Passenger loading zone 2 min max at school times
Dwelling within 12 m, clinic within 9 m
sun_shade: Mostly open to the south; large tree canopy shades from the north and east.
cannot_judge: Whether the junction apron is usable for stopping

best_section.where: South kerb of Cecil Street beside the junction islands, near the school drop-off
